recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle perspective shot of a two-lane asphalt highway receding toward a horizon under a twilight sky, framed by golden fields and topped with heavy, metallic-beveled display typography and a central circular emblem.
coreVisualRelationships: The road's vanishing point aligns with the vertical center of the typographic emblem.
The warm golden tones of the fields and text contrast against the deep blue and purple of the sky.
The heavy weight of the top logo is balanced by the dense block of tracklist text at the bottom.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The highway occupies the bottom half, creating a strong leading line. The main title dominates the top third, spanning the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular emblem containing a flag and star serves as the focal anchor between the sky and the road.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the road from the bottom center up to the horizon, then jumps to the large title at the top, finally settling on the tracklist details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides open space for the large title, while the road surface provides a dark canvas for the tracklist.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and purple sky providing a cool backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and ochre fields and road markings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Polished gold metallic finish on the primary logo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark asphalt and the bright, saturated gold text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with western flourishes
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated, curved serifs that connect adjacent letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminal serifs on the first and last letters extend into large, circular flourishes
Letters are tightly kerned to overlap and form a single cohesive shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, ornate custom display face paired with a clean, legible classic serif for information.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem with star and flag

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the western slab-serif aesthetic for the main title.
Provides the necessary legibility for the tracklist at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle landscape photo of a straight two-lane highway with double yellow lines receding into the distance. The landscape features golden dry grass fields under a twilight sky with soft, horizontal clouds in shades of blue and purple. A small barn is visible on the left horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arched, gold-beveled slab-serif title at the top. Below it, place a circular emblem with a star and flag. At the bottom, overlay a multi-line tracklist in a light gold serif font, centered over the road.

verificationChecks: Does the top text have a 3D metallic gold appearance?
Is the tracklist legible against the dark road?
Is the horizon line placed roughly at the vertical center?

adjustableVariables: Number of tracks in the list
mustRedesign: Exact letter flourishes of the original logo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold text doesn't look like flat yellow.
Check that the road lines lead the eye to the center.
Verify the tracklist is centered and balanced.
Confirm the sky has a smooth color gradient.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [landscape type] with a [central perspective element], apply a [metallic color] [western-style] display font at the top, and a [legible serif] list at the bottom.
